business.title: Always On the Ball
business.domain: whether I am always on the ball at work — in meetings, with guests, during busy shifts
business.correction_instruction: correct me gently if I make a mistake
business.push_instruction: speak clearly and at a comfortable pace
business.closing_instruction: tell me what I did well

business.title: A Piece of Cake at Work
business.expression: to be a piece of cake
business.role: a new colleague at the hotel
business.domain: which parts of my job I find easy — a piece of cake — and which parts I find more difficult
business.correction_instruction: correct me if I make a grammar mistake
business.push_instruction: use the expression naturally in your questions
business.closing_instruction: tell me what I did well

business.title: Clearing Up Confusion
business.role: a guest at Abadía Retuerta with a small misunderstanding or question about their booking, the restaurant, or the facilities
business.domain: I work at the hotel and I will try to clear up the confusion professionally
business.correction_instruction: correct me gently if I make a mistake
business.push_instruction: keep the conversation realistic and professional
business.closing_instruction: after the conversation, tell me what I did well

business.title: What's Frowned On Here?
business.role: my colleague at a luxury hotel
business.domain: things that are frowned on in our workplace — with guests, in the team, and in professional situations
business.push_instruction: push me to give detailed answers and use the expression naturally
business.closing_instruction: give me feedback at the end

business.title: When Things Get Messed Up
business.domain: situations at work where things have been messed up — by me, by a colleague, or by a supplier — and how I handled it
business.push_instruction: push me to speak in full sentences

business.title: Making Up and Making Excuses
business.domain: times at work when someone has made up an excuse, or when colleagues have fallen out and had to make up — both meanings
business.push_instruction: use the expression in both meanings
business.closing_instruction: give me feedback at the end

business.title: Starting From Scratch
business.role: a business consultant visiting Abadía Retuerta
business.domain: situations where we have had to start something from scratch — a new project, a new process, a new team approach
business.push_instruction: push me to be specific and use sophisticated vocabulary
business.closing_instruction: give me feedback at the end

business.title: Barging In at the Wrong Moment
business.role: my colleague at a luxury hotel
business.domain: situations where someone has barged in on a meeting, a guest conversation, or an important moment, and how I handled it
business.closing_instruction: tell me what I would do differently

business.title: Once in a Blue Moon
business.role: my manager, in a performance review at Abadía Retuerta
business.domain: things that only happen once in a blue moon at the hotel — rare guest requests, unusual situations, special events
business.push_instruction: push me to use the expression naturally
business.closing_instruction: give me feedback on my fluency at the end

fluency_techniques.title: Hesitation Fillers
fluency_techniques.trigger: a pause of more than three seconds
fluency_techniques.instruction: remind the student to use a filler: well, let me think, actually, you know, or to be honest

fluency_techniques.title: Speed & Rhythm
fluency_techniques.instruction: ask the student to repeat the answer faster and more confidently

fluency_techniques.title: Connectors
fluency_techniques.trigger: a short answer that could be expanded
fluency_techniques.instruction: push the student to expand it using: however, although, on the other hand, as a result, therefore, in addition, despite
